description: Heatmap of PF10342 domain pairwise identity across the Kre9/Knh1 family in S. pombe and S. cerevisiae
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, seaborn as sns
M=pd.read_csv('kre9_family_identity_matrix.csv',index_col=0)
short={'knh4 SCHPO (O42970)':'knh4 (Sp)','SPCC553.10 SCHPO (O74947)':'SPCC553.10 (Sp)',
       'SPBC11C11.05 SCHPO (Q10196)':'SPBC11C11.05 (Sp)','SPCC1322.10 SCHPO (O94549)':'SPCC1322.10 (Sp)',
       'Kre9 SACCE (P39005)':'Kre9 (Sc)','Knh1 SACCE (P50112)':'Knh1 (Sc)'}
M.index=[short[i] for i in M.index]; M.columns=[short[c] for c in M.columns]
order=['knh4 (Sp)','SPCC553.10 (Sp)','SPCC1322.10 (Sp)','SPBC11C11.05 (Sp)','Kre9 (Sc)','Knh1 (Sc)']
M=M.loc[order,order]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2,5.8))
sns.heatmap(M,annot=True,fmt='.1f',cmap='viridis',vmin=15,vmax=45,
            cbar_kws={'label':'percent identity'},ax=ax,linewidths=0.6,linecolor='white')
ax.set_title('PF10342 Kre9/Knh1 domain, pairwise percent identity\n(global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1)',fontsize=10)
for lbl in ax.get_yticklabels(): lbl.set_rotation(0)
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(),rotation=35,ha='right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(M.round(1).to_string())
kn=M.loc['knh4 (Sp)'].drop('knh4 (Sp)')
print("\nknh4 best match overall:",kn.idxmax(),round(kn.max(),1),"%")
print("knh4 vs S. pombe paralogs: mean %.1f  (range %.1f - %.1f)"%(
    kn[['SPCC553.10 (Sp)','SPCC1322.10 (Sp)','SPBC11C11.05 (Sp)']].mean(),
    kn[['SPCC553.10 (Sp)','SPCC1322.10 (Sp)','SPBC11C11.05 (Sp)']].min(),
    kn[['SPCC553.10 (Sp)','SPCC1322.10 (Sp)','SPBC11C11.05 (Sp)']].max()))
print("knh4 vs S. cerevisiae Kre9/Knh1: %.1f / %.1f"%(kn['Kre9 (Sc)'],kn['Knh1 (Sc)']))
print("Kre9-Knh1 (Sc paralog pair, known redundant): %.1f"%M.loc['Kre9 (Sc)','Knh1 (Sc)'])
print("\nAll pairs are in the twilight zone (<=41.8%); no pair reaches the ~50-60% typical of 1:1 orthologs.")
